I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."

         **Review examples:**

For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete.             3. _narwhalez123_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used!
